jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Am Standort Visp  suchen wir eine/n Mitarbeiter/in in der Distributions/Versandlogistik (Lonza Pharma Biotech & Nutrition).

Dies ist eine Stelle, die ausschließlich vor Ort ausgeübt wird. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit fördert eine enge, zeitnahe Kooperation und die technische Präzision, die für die Herstellung von Arzneimitteln nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards erforderlich ist.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Entgegennahme von Versandaufträgen sowie deren Weiterbearbeitung und termingerechte, korrekte Versandvorbereitung

• Durchführung temperaturkontrollierter Transporte (für Kunden, 3PL, interne Werkstransporte).

• Einsatz validierter Verpackungssysteme sowie Überwachung von Logger- & Monitoring-Daten.

• Vollständige Dokumentation aller Versand- und Temperaturdaten gemäß Vorschriften.

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von IATA-, ADR- und CBTA-Vorgaben.

• Teilnahme an vorgeschriebenen Schulungen

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller GMP-/GDP-Vorgaben und regulatorischen Anforderungen.

• Laufende Überprüfung interner Prozesse sowie Sicherstellung der korrekten Umsetzung bereichsübergreifender Optimierungsmaßnahmen

• Flexible Unterstützung bereichsübergreifender Logistik-Teams der Zentral-Logistik.

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder logistische Ausbildung mit eidg. Fähigkeitsausweis.

• Berufserfahrung in einem Pharmaunternehmen oder in einem GMP-regulierten Logistikumfeld.

• Gute Kenntnisse in GMP/GDP, Gefahrgutversand (IATA, ADR) und Cold Chain Handling.

• Praktische Erfahrung mit SAP EWM / WM.

• Hohe Flexibilität, Kommunikationsstärke, Belastbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit.

• Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen, ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt gross geschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.
Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Ihre Aufgaben
• Entgegennahme von Versandaufträgen sowie deren Weiterbearbeitung und termingerechte, korrekte Versandvorbereitung
• Durchführung temperaturkontrollierter Transporte (für Kunden, 3PL, interne Werkstransporte).
• Einsatz validierter Verpackungssysteme sowie Überwachung von Logger- & Monitoring-Daten.
• Vollständige Dokumentation aller Versand- und Temperaturdaten gemäß Vorschriften.
• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von IATA-, ADR- und CBTA-Vorgaben.
• Teilnahme an vorgeschriebenen Schulungen
• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller GMP-/GDP-Vorgaben und regulatorischen Anforderungen.
• Laufende Überprüfung interner Prozesse sowie Sicherstellung der korrekten Umsetzung bereichsübergreifender Optimierungsmaßnahmen
• Flexible Unterstützung bereichsübergreifender Logistik-Teams der Zentral-Logistik. Ihr Profil
• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder logistische Ausbildung mit eidg. Fähigkeitsausweis.
• Berufserfahrung in einem Pharmaunternehmen oder in einem GMP-regulierten Logistikumfeld.
• Gute Kenntnisse in GMP/GDP, Gefahrgutversand (IATA, ADR) und Cold Chain Handling.
• Praktische Erfahrung mit SAP EWM / WM.
• Hohe Flexibilität, Kommunikationsstärke, Belastbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit.
• Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. jobs.title: Senior Strategic Buyer Indirect IT/OT 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland.

The Senior Strategic Buyer Indirect IT/OT will be part of the Indirect Procurement team and reports to the Head of Indirect Procurement Categories: Technology, Professional Services & MRO. The successful candidate will collaborate effectively with the Global IT/OT Category manager and other Category Managers to deliver value and continuous improvement to assigned sites and their stakeholders.

The role of this person is to partner with key stakeholders to ensure business continuity and verify that procurement activities meet specific site business needs. You will provide essential purchasing expertise in tendering, negotiation, and contracting while managing the delegated spend.

The hired candidate will be responsible for driving savings initiatives by developing a pipeline of projects and realizing cost reductions with delegated suppliers. You will manage supplier relationships in liaison with delegated spend, overseeing an annual portfolio of up to 50 million.

You will also act as a support for the roll-out of new procurement policies, procedures, and tools, ensuring the optimization of transactional costs and efficiency across the organization.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.

Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Support Category Managers with category and sourcing strategy development by providing site-specific business needs and reporting local market trends.

• Execute sourcing initiatives for delegated spend across assigned sites, providing expertise in negotiation tactics and planning.

• Manage the supplier portfolio to leverage capabilities, improve supply continuity, and reduce the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

• Track country savings performance and identify potential risks and opportunities within the supply chain.

• Identify and partner with site stakeholders (Budget owners, Legal, etc.) to understand and support current and future business needs.

• Drive the utilization of leading-edge sourcing tools, including on-line catalogues and E-Auctions.

• Perform comprehensive supply risk assessments across the existing supplier portfolio, including financial and quality risks.

• Ensure the ERP system and RM documentation databases are accurately maintained.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Procurement, or Supply Chain.

• 5–10 years of experience in Strategic Procurement; experience within the Pharma or a high-quality industry is preferred.

• Business fluent in English.

• Expertise in procurement processes: category management, supplier management, and contract management.

• Hands-on experience using SAP, Ariba, and Microsoft Office.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously.

• Ability to persuade and influence suppliers to achieve the best outcomes for the business.

• Knowledge of process improvement and a customer service-oriented mindset.

• Willingness to adhere to GMP standards and safety procedures at all times.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Senior Deviation Specialist - 80-100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Der Deviation Manager (m/w/d) untersucht Abweichungen in unseren Biokonjugationsanlagen in MC1 und PCP (Protein Conjugation Plant).

Er/Sie vertritt die Operations-Einheit, übernimmt die Verantwortung für auftretende Abweichungen, untersucht deren Ursachen und potenzielle Auswirkungen auf Produkte und/oder Systeme und definiert geeignete CAPAs als Lösungen.

Was auf Sie wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Verantwortung für die Übernahme, Untersuchung, Erstellung und Dokumentation zugewiesener Abweichungen.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Fachexperten (SMEs) und wichtigen Stakeholdern, um die Ursachen von Abweichungen und deren potenzielle Auswirkungen auf Produkte und/oder Systeme zu ermitteln.

• Sicherstellen, dass geeignete Untersuchungstools verwendet werden, um systematisch alle Ursachen und beitragenden Faktoren zu identifizieren (z. B. Logic Fault Tree, Defence Analysis, Event & Causal Factors Chart, Fishbone, Human Factor Checklist).

• Definition und Abstimmung geeigneter CAPAs und zugehöriger Wirksamkeitsprüfungen mit SMEs.

• Sicherstellung der cGMP-Compliance und Konsistenz während des gesamten Untersuchungsprozesses sowie termingerechte Fertigstellung und Schließung der Qualitätsdokumente.

• Unterstützung des Unternehmens bei laufenden Veränderungen und Prozessverbesserungen.

Was wir suchen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Chemie, Biotechnologie, Life Sciences oder einem verwandten Bereich; Master oder PhD von Vorteil.

• 1–2 Jahre Erfahrung in einer cGMP-regulierten pharmazeutischen/API-Industrie; Kenntnisse in Operations (Herstellung) und im Umgang mit Abweichungen von Vorteil.

• Kenntnisse in biotechnologischen oder biokonjugationsbezogenen Herstellungsprozessen; Kenntnisse analytischer Methoden von Vorteil.

• Erfahrung mit Human and Organizational Performance sowie Risikomanagement-Ansätzen ist ein Plus.

• Sehr gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

• Technisches Schreiben sowie Präsentations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sind entscheidend; nachgewiesene Erfahrung ist ein großer Vorteil.

• Strukturierte, fokussierte und gut organisierte Arbeitsweise; agil, hochmotiviert und dynamisch.

• Fähigkeit, mit einem Team von SMEs ohne formale Weisungsbefugnis zusammenzuarbeiten sowie eigenständig vollständige und termingerechte Dokumente zu liefern.

​Wir bieten attraktive Benefits sowie ein umfassendes Relocation-Paket für talentierte neue Mitarbeitende.

Über Lonza

jobs.title: Scientist QC Microbiology 100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join us as Scientist in our QC Microbiology department and become part of an exciting growth project for a new sterile drug product facility! Check out your career at Drug Product Services (DPS)

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

What you’ll do:

• Routine execution and coordination of microbiological testing including environmental monitoring, bacterial endotoxins-, bioburden- and sterility testing etc.

• Adhere to GMP regulations to ensure flawless operations

• Perform, develop, establish and improve microbiological testing procedures, e.g. method suitability testing and provide training for test methods

• Support microbiology-related projects, such as implementation of new methods

• Ensure appropriate maintenance of equipment, safety and health protection following laboratory and safety instructions and all cGMP regulations

• Train analytical methods and/or corresponding instruments

What we’re looking for:

• Education as Lab Technician, Bachelor or equivalent in Microbiology or Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences or related fields

• Working experience in microbiological testing, preferably in pharmaceutical industry working under cGMP Regulations

• Sound working knowledge in all (and in-depth knowledge in at least one) relevant microbiological test types (environmental monitoring, endotoxin, bioburden and sterility testing)

• Knowledge with automated systems (e.g. Growth direct, Pyrotec Pro) is an asset

• Excellent communication skills

• Fluency in written and spoken English, German is an asset

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: MSAT Expert Drug Product 80-100%
jobs.description:
he actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Become an MSAT Expert at Lonza AG for an exciting Greenfield project in Stein AG Switzerland! Support the commercial readiness of a large-scale aseptic fill&finish facility for Biologics.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• Along with competitive salaries, you’ll find a wide range of lifestyle, family and leisure benefits available. The full list of our local benefits can be also found on assetstream.aspx

Key responsibilities:

• Act as the MSAT Expert in capital investment projects to build and commission manufacturing units, ensuring commercial readiness for the GMP manufacturing facility.

• Define qualification strategies and concepts for DP manufacturing equipment and clean rooms as part of the aseptic fill&finish lines in alignment with regulatory requirements (e.g EU GMP, FDA, ICH). Lead and act as a MSAT member in cross-functional project teams (e.g QA, Engineering, Manufacturing, QC).

• Provide technical leadership during the design of the sterile manufacturing processes, including cleanroom layout, material/personnel flow, and equipment placement.

• Craft the Aseptic Process Simulation concept in alignment with internal guidelines and regulatory requirements. Provide oversight and technical support during execution of APS and all investigations regarding the aseptic manufacturing process. Support the development of aseptic technique training programs.

• Lead risk assessments (e.g FMEA) to identify critical manufacturing process parameters and control strategies for the facility. Author and review GMP documents such as Qualification/Validation master plans, protocols and reports, SOPs, manufacturing concepts, etc.

• Ensure GMP documentation readiness for authority inspections in line with internal and external quality standards.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of standardized MSAT procedures and processes, including qualification standards, single-use systems, and filtration systems.

Key requirements:

• University Degree or equivalent technical education in Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field

• Significant experience in aseptic/sterile fill&finish processes of drug products in a GMP environment is a must, with substantial know-how in aseptic processing and sterility assurance principles.

• Experience in at least one of the following is a must: qualification of manufacturing equipment; cleaning validation; room qualification

• Strong communication skills, able to translate complex technical topics into clear actionable messages.

• Proactive, positive approach, problem-solving attitude, and ability to take full responsibility for assigned areas.

• Ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive decision-making in a matrix organization; build strong networks and trust across internal and external stakeholders.

• Proficiency in English is a must; German language skills are a plus.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Process Analytics & Operational Data Intelligence Expert

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di Process Analytics & Operational Data Intelligence
titleByLocale.en: Process Analytics & Operational Data Intelligence Expert
titleByLocale.de: Process Analytics & Operational Data Intelligence Expert
titleByLocale.fr: Process Analytics & Operational Data Intelligence Expert

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world — and that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.
The actual location of this role is in Visp. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

About the Role

Within the Process Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI) team, embedded directly within Operations and Process Development, we work at the intersection of process understanding, operational performance, process improvement, and data intelligence.

We do not see data, dashboards, or GMP deliverables as isolated reporting activities. Every dataset, every process trend, every recurring manual task, every deviation investigation, and every operational pain point is an opportunity to improve how the organization operates.

We are looking for a Process Analytics & Operational Intelligence Expert who combines process understanding, analytical thinking, operational curiosity, and technical data capabilities to help drive continuous improvement across process development and manufacturing environments.
This role combines:

• Process analytics

• Operational intelligence

• Process improvement

• Data analysis

• Foundational data workflows

• GMP operational support

• Advanced process monitoring

What You Will Do

• Build trusted, analytics-ready datasets by integrating, contextualizing, and structuring operational data from systems such as PI, MES, ELN, instrument platforms, and manufacturing data sources.

• Work closely with mammalian manufacturing and process teams to understand how operational data is generated, used, and interpreted within real manufacturing and GMP workflows.

• Analyze process trends, variability, bottlenecks, and performance drivers across batches, campaigns, and workflows using statistical and analytical techniques.

• Develop operational dashboards, analytical views, and process intelligence solutions used daily by MSAT, Process Development, Manufacturing, QA, and Operations teams

• Translate complex operational and manufacturing datasets into actionable insights and improvement opportunities that support process robustness and operational performance.

• Support GMP deliverables and reporting activities while identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve underlying data and operational workflows.

• Improve operational data quality, traceability, contextualization, and usability to enable scalable analytics and reliable decision-making.

• Collaborate closely with MSAT, Manufacturing, QA, Automation, IT, and global data teams to deliver scalable, operationally relevant, and production-ready data and analytics solutions.

Who You Are

• You are passionate about turning complex process and manufacturing data into actionable insights and scalable solutions.

• You think beyond dashboards and reporting, focusing on how data can improve process understanding, operational performance, and decision-making.

• You are comfortable working close to mammalian manufacturing and process teams to understand operational context, data meaning, and business needs.

• You enjoy working at the intersection of analytics, operational data, process improvement, and digital transformation.

• You are curious about how data is generated, structured, contextualized, and consumed across operational environments.

• You communicate clearly and can translate complex datasets and analyses into practical recommendations for operational and scientific stakeholders.

• You are hands-on, collaborative, and comfortable working across technical, scientific, and operational teams.

• You are motivated by solving real operational challenges and building scalable solutions that can be embedded into day-to-day operations.

What You Bring
Experience or strong exposure to:

• Operational analytics

• Manufacturing/process data

• Industrial or operational data environments

Practical knowledge of:

• SQL

• Python

• Statistical analysis

• Dashboarding and visualization

• Data pipelines or ETL concepts

Exposure to tools such as:

• Seeq

• Statistica

• SIMCA

• Power BI

• PI System

• Azure

• Git

• Or equivalent analytics/data platforms

CDMO experience or understanding of mammalian manufacturing, process development, or bioprocess operations is strongly preferred.

Interest in:

• Process behavior and variability

• Manufacturing operations

• GMP process support

• Continuous improvement

• Digital transformation

Why Join PADI
The Process Analytics & Data Intelligence (PADI) team connects data assets and people to unlock operational performance, strengthen process understanding, and drive smarter decisions across the organization.
PADI is embedded directly within Operations and Process Development, working closely with MSAT, Manufacturing, QA, Automation, and global teams to solve real operational and process challenges through analytics, operational intelligence, and scalable data solutions.
This is not a traditional data role. Every dashboard, GMP deliverable, workflow, and operational request is treated as an opportunity to improve processes, simplify complexity, increase scalability, and strengthen operational excellence.
You will work at the intersection of:

• Operations

• Process Science

• Manufacturing

• Data Intelligence

helping shape the future of data-driven process development and manufacturing in a highly collaborative, innovation-driven, and operationally connected environment.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Laboratory Scientist Physico-Chemical Quality Control 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland.

For our successful and growing Drug Product focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the Laboratory Scientist Phys-Chemical QC position.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you’ll do:

• Independently execute routine physico-chemical testing such as U/HPLC (SEC, IEX, RP, surfactant), CE-SDS, icIEF, protein content, and compendial methods (pH, color, clarity, subvisible particles, etc.) for biologics/large molecules, related entities and small molecules in QC under cGMP following applicable SOPs and Good Documentation Practices (GDocP) in a right-first-time and timely manner

• Executes/reviews/approves basic laboratory operational tasks, e.g. mobile phase preparation or calibration/troubleshooting of laboratory equipment

• Assist in investigation/troubleshooting of laboratory equipment issues by provision of technical knowledge on the equipment to the Business Process Owner

• Support maintaining the 6s standard within the laboratory by actively following and keeping up 6s processes for chemical inventory & consumables management, thereby ensuring audit/inspection readiness as well as supporting them.

• Leads organization and on time conduction of maintenance/requalification of assigned laboratory equipment, supported by external vendors, as Instrument Responsible Person (Cat A and B). Act as trainer for assigned equipment in combination of respective analytical methods

• Support analytical method validation or transfers as required

• Proactively contribute to laboratory operational optimization and process improvement initiatives

• Contributes to Pikett Service for Drug Product analytical infrastructure

What we’re looking for:

• Training on the job as a lab technician (EFZ, HF, CTA, BTA, PTA or BSc./MSc.)

• Working experience in a research/ technical role in the pharmaceutical, biotech or chemical industry, in analytical testing

• Proven working experience in a cGMP regulated environment in phys-chem analytics strongly desired with experience in accurately reporting, interpretation and documentation of scientific results following ALCOA++ GDocP principles

• Experience with laboratory specific software (e.g. Empower, Electronic Laboratory Journal, LIMS-system) is advantageous

• Good communication and ability to work independently in a team, proactive and dedicated attitude

• Good knowledge of written and spoken English. Any other languages are a plus

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Independently execute routine physico-chemical testing such as U/HPLC (SEC, IEX, RP, surfactant), CE-SDS, icIEF, protein content, and compendial methods (pH, color, clarity, subvisible particles, etc.) for biologics/large molecules, related entities and small molecules in QC under cGMP following applicable SOPs and Good Documentation Practices (GDocP) in a right-first-time and timely manner
• Executes/reviews/approves basic laboratory operational tasks, e.g. mobile phase preparation or calibration/troubleshooting of laboratory equipment
• Assist in investigation/troubleshooting of laboratory equipment issues by provision of technical knowledge on the equipment to the Business Process Owner
• Support maintaining the 6s standard within the laboratory by actively following and keeping up 6s processes for chemical inventory & consumables management, thereby ensuring audit/inspection readiness as well as supporting them.
• Leads organization and on time conduction of maintenance/requalification of assigned laboratory equipment, supported by external vendors, as Instrument Responsible Person (Cat A and B). Act as trainer for assigned equipment in combination of respective analytical methods
• Support analytical method validation or transfers as required
• Proactively contribute to laboratory operational optimization and process improvement initiatives
• Contributes to Pikett Service for Drug Product analytical infrastructure What we’re looking for:
• Training on the job as a lab technician (EFZ, HF, CTA, BTA, PTA or BSc./MSc.)
• Working experience in a research/ technical role in the pharmaceutical, biotech or chemical industry, in analytical testing
• Proven working experience in a cGMP regulated environment in phys-chem analytics strongly desired with experience in accurately reporting, interpretation and documentation of scientific results following ALCOA++ GDocP principles
• Experience with laboratory specific software (e.g. Empower, Electronic Laboratory Journal, LIMS-system) is advantageous
• Good communication and ability to work independently in a team, proactive and dedicated attitude
• Good knowledge of written and spoken English. Any other languages are a plus About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Vorbereitung und Bereitstellung von Produktionsmaterialien

• Abwicklung von Versandaufträgen

• Ansprechpartner für 3PL-Dienstleister und Durchführung von Umlagerungen

• Unterstützung/Leitung von Verbesserungsprojekten sowie Pflege und Einhaltung von SOPs

• Erstbearbeitung von Abweichungen und Change Requests

• Unterstützung bei Audits, Inventuren und Lagerbestandskontrollen

• Durchführung von delegierten Musterzügen unter Einhaltung der GMP Vorschriften.

Was wir suchen:

• Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Lagerlogistik, idealerweise im pharmeutischen GMP Umfeld (Erfahrung im Wareneingang, Warenausgang und in der Produktionslogistik wird vorausgesetzt)

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung, z. B. Logistiker EFZ oder Fachkraft für Lagerlogistik. Weiterbildung zum Logistikfachmann/-fachfrau von Vorteil.

• Kenntnisse in WM/EWM; TrackWise Erfahrung von Vorteil

jobs.title: MSAT Process Expert Mammalian Upstream Large-Scale (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.it: MSAT Process Expert Mammifero a monte su larga scala (m/f/d)
titleByLocale.en: MSAT Process Expert Mammalian Upstream Large-Scale (m/f/d)
titleByLocale.de: MSAT Process Expert Mammalian Upstream Large-Scale (m/f/d)
titleByLocale.fr: MSAT Process Expert Mammalian Upstream Large-Scale (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

The site in Visp, Switzerland is growing and for our Biologics organization, we are currently looking for experienced Process Experts and Senior Process Experts in Ibex® Solutions, our recently launched unique biological manufacturing and development concept. We have opportunities in both USP and DSP in Drug Substance for mammalian large-scale manufacturing (up to 20.000L). As a process owner, you are responsible for the successful scale up, supervision and optimization of mammalian processes. Become part of this great opportunity and apply now!

Key responsibilities:

• You lead multi-functional teams tasked with technology transfers (process design and up-scaling) and timely process implementation at manufacturing scale

• You act as the interface between the process donor (customer, process development) and manufacturing

• You directly connect with customers during campaign preparation, execution and closure including regular reporting of batch status and process performance

• You are responsible for the resolution of process issues that may arise during manufacturing considering all regulatory requirements

• You secure technology transfer success by applying standardized processes and tools to manage the transfer of information, process related risks and change control

Key requirements:

• Bachelor, Master's degree or PhD or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, chemical engineering or related field

• Significant experience in the area of biopharma manufacturing and / or process development preferably in Mammalian Manufacturing (large-scale)

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English and/or German

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Intern - QA Specialist Batch Record Review

titleByLocale.it: Tirocinante - QA Specialista Batch Record Review
titleByLocale.en: Intern - QA Specialist Batch Record Review
titleByLocale.de: Praktikant - QA Spezialist Batch Record Review
titleByLocale.fr: Stagiaire - QA Spécialiste Batch Record Review

jobs.description:
The Batch Record Review Intern supports the Quality Assurance team (QA OPS) by assisting in the review, verification, and organization of electronic GMP manufacturing documentation. This role provides hands‑on exposure to regulated industry practices, including data integrity, documentation control, and compliance with internal procedures and regulatory standards. The intern will work closely with QA specialists and cross‑functional teams to ensure timely and accurate batch record processing.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

What you will do:

• Review of the Executed Batch Records (e.g. cleaning logs, production documentation review, temperature reports, test procedures, raw data, logbooks)

• Review comments added to the Executed Batch Records, clarify with the operations team and evaluate with the responsible QA Manager

• Support the initiation of deviations and investigations for Batch Record review related observations

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor degree or relevant work/ internship experience in Biology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Life Science or other related field

• Previous experience in GMP regulated pharmaceutical / API industry is an advantage

• Ability to identify non-compliance and gaps from quality standards

• Structured, precise and well-organized working attitude; open-minded for new ideas and suggestions; agile, highly motivated and dynamic drive

• English: Fluent. German: Good to have.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: EI&C IT/OT Senior Project Lead 80-100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our Engineering team in Visp as an EI&C IT/OT Senior Project Lead 80-100% (m/f/d) and drive the evolution of our MES landscape across its full lifecycle. In this role, you’ll shape digital manufacturing by leading MES projects, strengthening system standards, and ensuring GMP‑compliant, high‑impact system performance.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you’ll do:

• Execute and lead MES projects across all lifecycle phases, including requirement analysis, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.

• Maintain, optimize, and further develop MES standards, ensuring consistency, compliance, and alignment with site and global guidelines.

• Ensure reliable operation, enhancement, and updating of MES systems, recognizing their direct impact on production processes and GMP‑compliant documentation.

• Collaborate closely with Operations, QA, Automation, and IT/OT teams to ensure seamless system integration and high system availability.

• Analyze and improve MES‑related workflows, identifying opportunities for digitalization, efficiency gains, and data integrity improvements.

• Coordinate and manage external partners and vendors involved in MES or OT‑related project and support activities.

• Ensure GMP‑compliant execution of all MES and OT activities, including documentation, change control, and validation readiness.

What we are looking for:

• Completed university degree in Computer Science, Industrial IT/OT, Automation Engineering, or a related field (Bachelor level or higher).

• Significant professional experience in IT/OT, MES, or automation‑related engineering roles within a regulated environment.

• Solid understanding of GMP requirements and experience working with validated production or automation systems.

• Responsibility for the MES lifecycle, including system operation, enhancements, release management, and interface coordination.

• Strong knowledge of OT networks, virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware), system architectures, and basic cybersecurity principles.

• Fluent German or English (minimum B2 level) for effective collaboration with local and global stakeholders.

• Structured, independent working style with strong communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Willingness to participate in on‑call duty (Pikettdienst) 2-3 times per year.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

In the role of the Manufacturing Line Specialist - Anlagemeister (AM) you ensure through intensive technical and organizational support of production campaigns in a 6x20k multipurpose, mammalian large-scale facility, the manufacturing of therapeutic proteins for our commercial customers while adhering to HSE, hygiene, and cGMP guidelines.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Equipment availability – this includes HSE, tidiness, cleanliness and coordination of maintenance & calibration of state-of-the-art equipment in collaboration with internal technical stakeholders. Serve as first point of contact in equipment malfunctions and lead the troubleshooting in close collaboration with the Bioprocess Engineers.

• Training - Ensuring that employees assigned to a project or equipment have a good level of training regarding cGMP, HSE, hygiene, and technical competencies.

• Cross-functional - Support the manufacturing of therapeutic products through risk analyses, equipment modification, technical optimizations and coordination of routine technical tasks.

• Culture - Implements the One-Lonza vision and culture and supports its further development through openness to change, new ideas, and continuous improvements.

What we are looking for:

• Completed apprenticeship as a biotechnological/pharmaceutical/chemical technologist (chemical technician) or B.Sc./M.Sc. degree in technical or scientific field with relevant work experience in large-scale biotechnological plants.

• You demonstrate high flexibility, teamwork ability, organizational skills, and strong commitment.

• Fluency in English (spoken/written), German is considered a plus.

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

The site in Visp, Switzerland is growing and for our Biologics organization, we are currently looking for experienced Process Experts and Senior Process Experts in Ibex® Solutions, our recently launched unique biological manufacturing and development concept. We have opportunities in both USP and DSP in Drug Substance for mammalian large-scale manufacturing (up to 20.000L). As a process owner, you are responsible for the successful scale up, supervision and optimization of mammalian processes. Become part of this great opportunity and apply now!

Key responsibilities:

• You lead multi-functional teams tasked with technology transfers (process design and up-scaling) and timely process implementation at manufacturing scale

• You act as the interface between the process donor (customer, process development) and manufacturing

• You directly connect with customers during campaign preparation, execution and closure including regular reporting of batch status and process performance

• You are responsible for the resolution of process issues that may arise during manufacturing considering all regulatory requirements

• You secure technology transfer success by applying standardized processes and tools to manage the transfer of information, process related risks and change control

Key requirements:

• Bachelor, Master's degree or PhD or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, chemical engineering or related field

• Significant experience in the area of biopharma manufacturing and / or process development preferably in Mammalian Manufacturing (large-scale)

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English and/or German

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
